comment: Golden ledger for fixtures/drifted/ (GH issue #991). The gate (tests/run-fixture-check.sh) passes only if the deterministic checker reports EXACTLY these findings on drifted/ (zero invented, zero missed) and ZERO findings on clean/. Identity is the tuple (check, fact_class, kind, surfaces); id, description, and severity are documentation. All findings here are deterministic — LLM-judged fact classes are advisory-only and never appear in this ledger.

findings.description: README version badge says 2.2.0 but the owner surface package.json says 2.3.0 (skill check 3.2, Category 1 status drift).
docs/index.md 'Last updated: 2025-11-02' is 241 days before the fixed clock 2026-07-01, beyond the registry staleness bound of 180 days (date-staleness drift).
README tells developers to run 'npm test' but no CI step runs that command — CI runs 'npm run test:unit' (skill check 3.3, Category 4 CI/validation drift).
README references docs/usage.md in prose but the file does not exist (skill check 3.8, Category 7 reference drift).
000-INDEX.md lists 002-DR-SPEC-widget-format.md but the file is not on disk (skill check 3.1, Category 7 index drift).
000-docs/003-OD-NOTE-release-checklist.md exists on disk but is not listed in 000-INDEX.md (skill check 3.1, Category 7 index drift).
CLAUDE.md's key-documents table references docs/architecture.md, which does not exist (skill check 3.4, Category 7 reference drift).
CLAUDE.md claims 'scaffold only — no application code yet' while source files exist under src/ (skill check 3.5, Category 1 status drift).
README says Apache-2.0 but the owner surface package.json says MIT (skill check 3.7, Category 6 cross-doc contradiction).
README's Commands table claims an 'export' command that src/cli.js never registers (skill check 3.6 mechanical subset, Category 3 capability drift).
planning/roadmap.md marks 'list' as Planned but src/cli.js already registers it (skill check 3.9 mechanical subset, Category 5 planning-vs-implementation confusion).

Tagline conflicts across README.md ('The fastest widget toolkit...') and docs/index.md ('A friendly widget toolkit...') and product.tagline has NO registry row in sot-map — unowned fact-class, human adjudication needed; the checker must not guess a winner (council constraint).
